settings.title: How do I know if CURVJEANS will fit me?
settings.content:
We get it—finding jeans that actually fit is a struggle. That’s why CURVJEANS are designed specifically for smaller waists and wider hips.

Check our size guide with real measurements and do our fit quiz or simply DM us! Still unsure? Our returns are super easy.

settings.title: What if I’m between sizes?
settings.content: If you're in between, we usually recommend sizing down — our denim is super stretchy and molds to your body after a few wears. Still unsure? Check our size guide or send us a DM — we’re happy to help!

settings.title: Are they really that comfortable?
settings.content: YES. CURVJEANS feel like your favorite leggings but look like your best jeans. No stiff fabrics, no digging in, just all-day comfort and the stretch you’ve been craving.

settings.title: Will they lose shape after wearing?
settings.content: Nope! Our premium stretch denim has a bounce-back effect — it hugs your curves without stretching out or sagging over time.

settings.title: What if they're not the one?
settings.content: No stress! Not head over heels? Send them back within 14 days - it's that easy! Our returns means zero drama 💕

settings.title: Can I pay later?
settings.content: Yep! Just select Klarna at checkout and you can try now, pay later—no extra fees. Super easy, super safe.

settings.title: When will I receive my order?
settings.content: Can't wait to get your perfect jeans? We get it! Your CURVJEANS will arrive in 5-6 working days. We'll keep you updated every step of the way! 📦✨
